notes: The key insight from E12 (x=18.9 → -302.4 = -16.8·18) plus E9/E11 is that both linear regions use **floor(x)**: y = -0.7·floor(x) on the left and y = -16.8·floor(x) on the right. This explains the "slight slope errors" at non-integer x that v3 missed. The right breakpoint is between 18.5 and 18.9 (E6 vs E12), so I set it at 18.6 (marked uncertain).
